The refrigeration cycle refers to the circulation of refrigerant sealed in pipes through a cycle consisting of components such as the compressor, condenser and evaporator; as the refrigerant circulates through the cycle, it repeatedly changes from gas to liquid to gas, absorbing heat from the cabin and releasing it outside the cabin to provide cooling.
In consideration of ozone layer depletion, chlorine-free HFC-134a (R-134a) is used as the air conditioning refrigerant.
To prevent incorrect filling of compressor oil, the applicable refrigerant and type of applicable compressor oil are clearly indicated on the underside of the hood panel and on the compressor.
Air conditioning systems that use HFC-134a (R-134a) use dedicated parts and joints for each part. If parts other than the dedicated parts are used, refrigerant leaks may occur.
Be very careful, as compressors, compressor oil, O-rings, etc. not intended for HFC-134a may be used by mistake.

In conventional automatic air conditioning control, the air conditioning computer calculates the required outlet temperature TAO (heat load) from the set temperature and temperature information from each sensor according to a fixed formula, and automatically controls each servo motor and the blower motor according to the calculated TAO (heat load), keeping the cabin temperature stable for occupant comfort. However, even with the same TAO (heat load), individual occupants' sensations vary greatly depending on the surrounding environmental conditions, and with conventional automatic air conditioning control, in which all control is determined by the TAO (heat load) calculated by a formula, it was difficult to match the occupants' sensations, which are complex and difficult to express in a formula, under all conditions. Therefore, a neural network (nerve cell network) has been adopted as a method of performing more advanced control matched to occupants' sensations. A neural network is an engineering imitation of information processing in a biological nervous system (Fig. A); it replaces the input-output relationship of complex nerve transmission, like that of human nerve cells (neurons), with neuron models and combines several of them, and consists of an input layer, an intermediate layer and an output layer. (Fig. B)

The neural network consists of neurons in the input layer, intermediate layer and output layer; the input layer (neurons) processes information such as outside air temperature, solar radiation and room temperature from the switches and sensor outputs and outputs it to the intermediate layer (neurons), the intermediate layer (neurons) adjusts the strength of the connections (weighting) between neurons based on this, and the output layer (neurons) calculates the sum as control values for the required outlet temperature, solar correction, target airflow and outlet mode. Accordingly, the air conditioning computer controls each servo motor and the blower motor according to the control values calculated by the neural network.
